observed_failure: A selected UAOS conversation turn finalized without the Session 1.9 mandatory progress report. The subsequent diagnosis initially overreached by describing the system as lacking per-turn enforcement, even though SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY already requires an always-on problem sentinel, canonical-kernel activation for detected problems, and a mandatory final progress report.
verified_existing_mechanism: config/SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY.json requires a lightweight problem-detection sentinel on every selected-agent assistant turn.

When a problem signal is observed, deliberation_state cannot truthfully be NOT_TRIGGERED and evolution_state cannot truthfully be NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER unless the observation is explicitly classified as non-problematic.
Every final assistant response after controller/task selection requires a compact progress report with ten semantic fields.
Kernel root-scope and problem-closure admissions remain executable fail-closed gates when invoked.

competing_hypotheses.evidence: One confirmed missing-report event proves an adherence failure but is insufficient to estimate recurrence or long-run stability.

The current Session 1.9 contract explicitly scopes the sentinel to every assistant turn and the progress report to every final selected-context response; ambiguity is not supported by the authority text.

Host-level interception could provide stronger assurance, but one adherence escape does not establish that the existing session-mediated mechanism is inadequate. Escalation requires repeated measured failures or a demonstrated non-bypass requirement.

Before PR #40, tests verified that the policy declared every-turn sentinel/report semantics but there was no evaluator that could mechanically classify a concrete final response as missing the report or contradicting current problem state.

assurance_boundary: This change proves that Session 1.9 conversational adherence can now be mechanically evaluated from observable final-response fields when the caller supplies the known problem-signal state. It does not prove stable future adherence, does not infer hidden chain-of-thought, and does not physically intercept every host response.
promotion_rule: Do not escalate to host/runtime interception merely because it sounds stronger. First accumulate real multi-turn adherence samples. Escalate architecture only if measured repeated escapes, unacceptable adherence rate, or a hard non-bypass requirement demonstrates that session-mediated enforcement is insufficient.
remaining_work: collect real selected-context conversation samples across clean turns, user corrections, contradictions, research gaps and repair closures
